title: package disable: a disabled package's objectExtensions fields stay in /meta/object, /data and on the record page, while its objects answer 404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED
body:
## Source

Measured by HotCRM on platform **18.3.0** during hotcrm#2315 phase 0 (PR hotcrm#2413, report [hotcrm#2315 comment 6650597139](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2315#issuecomment-6650597139)). The screenshot `e-disabled-field-still-shown.png` is in the HotCRM project files under `issue-2315/`. The maintainer's ruling of 2026-11-05 on hotcrm#2315 relies on module disable to hide a module's extension fields from tenants that do not use the module.

## What happens

1. `PATCH /api/v1/packages/app.objectstack.hotcrm.o2c/disable` answers 200.
2. These are then withheld:
   - the module's sidebar entry and navigation group;
   - its object (`GET /api/v1/data/crm_o2c_probe` answers 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`);
   - its related tab on the contract page.
3. Its `objectExtensions` field on the app's `crm_contract`, the summary `o2c_probe_total`, is **still served**:
   - in `GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_contract`;
   - in `GET /api/v1/data/crm_contract/<id>` (value 2000);
   - on the console record page.

## Where (objectstack `main`)

- The object fold (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, around L4723–4760) keeps a disabled contributor's extension fields on the served object.
- The customizations read (`readBaseContributions`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`) lists them too. objectstack#30086 records that the spec docblock says the opposite. That card is about the docblock text. This one asks for the behaviour.
- Package disable already withholds the package's flows, navigation items, objects, permissions and actions.

## Ask

A disabled package's `objectExtensions` fields should be withheld the way its objects are: dropped from the folded object that `/meta/object` serves, from `/data` reads and writes, and from the record page. Re-enabling brings them back, with the stored values intact. The spec docblock of #30086 then becomes true as written.

## Consumer

hotcrm#2315 phase 1 (the O2C module's contract and account fields) is Blocked-by this card. The same holds for hotcrm#2316 (PSA), which takes the same module shape.
